translate_en|mods/MoonlightMayhem/42/med: Moonlight Mayhem
Night Zombie Speed
Zombie speed during the active night hours. Default is 1. 1 = Sprinters, 2 = Fast Shamblers, 3 = Shamblers, 4 = Random.
Tracking Pulse Frequency
How often the player tracking pulse fires while the event is active. Default is 180 ticks. Lower happens more often and is more intense but heavier. Higher is calmer and lighter.
Tracking Pulse Radius
How far the night tracking pulse reaches. Default is 250 tiles. Higher pulls zombies from farther away but can be heavier. Lower is safer for performance.
Tracking Pulse Strength
How strong the tracking sound is. Default is 250. Higher makes zombies respond more aggressively to the pulse. Lower makes it weaker.
Night Player Tracking Pulse
When ON, the mod creates a timed sound pulse during active Moonlight Mayhem hours only. Default is OFF. When the night ends, the pulse stops and cleanup runs.
Days Between Events
Controls how often Moonlight Mayhem repeats. Default is 1, meaning every night. 2 means every other night, 3 means every third night.
Debug Console Messages
Shows Moonlight Mayhem messages in the console. Default is OFF. Turn this ON only when testing or troubleshooting.
Enable Night Zombie Spawns
When ON, extra zombies can spawn near the player during Moonlight Mayhem. Default is OFF. This is separate from changing existing zombies; existing zombies are handled by the refresh settings.
Enable Moonlight Mayhem
Turns the whole mod on or off. ON means the mod checks the chosen time window and applies the night zombie settings. OFF means it stops changing zombie behavior.
End Hour
The hour when Moonlight Mayhem ends, using 24-hour time. Default is 6, which means 6 AM. Zombies are restored to normal after this time.
End Minute
The minute when the event ends. Default is 0. Example: End Hour 6 and End Minute 30 means the event ends at 6:30 AM.
Off-Hours Zombie Speed
The speed zombies return to when Moonlight Mayhem ends. Default is 3, normal Shamblers. This also acts as a backup if the original speed cannot be read.
First Event Day
The first survival day Moonlight Mayhem can happen. Default is 1, meaning it can start on the first night.
Instant Change Limit
How many loaded zombies are refreshed immediately when night starts or ends. Default is 300. Higher values change more zombies immediately; lower values are safer for performance.
Loaded Zombie Alert Radius
How far loaded zombies are directly pushed toward the player during Moonlight Mayhem. Default is 120 tiles. This only affects zombies already loaded nearby.
Cleanup Passes After End
Extra cleanup checks after Moonlight Mayhem ends. Default is 30. Higher values do more follow-up cleanup so spawned or loaded zombies return to daytime settings after the event ends.
Existing Zombie Check Speed
How often the mod checks whether it should be night or day mode. Default is 300. Lower values check more often but may add stutter; higher values check less often and can be smoother.
Night Spawn Chance
Chance that a night spawn attempt actually happens. Default is 100. Lower values make spawns less reliable and easier on performance.
Night Spawn Amount
How many zombies to spawn per successful night spawn. Default is 5. Higher is harder but can hurt performance.
Night Spawn Frequency
How many in-game minutes between night spawn attempts. Default is 30. Lower means more frequent spawns. Higher means fewer spawns.
Maximum Spawn Distance
Farthest distance extra night zombies can spawn from the player. Default is 120 tiles. Higher spreads spawns farther out; lower keeps them closer.
Minimum Spawn Distance
Closest distance extra night zombies can spawn from the player. Default is 45 tiles. Higher keeps spawns farther away from the player.
Start Hour
The hour when Moonlight Mayhem begins, using 24-hour time. Default is 18, which means 6 PM. Zombies switch to the night settings when this time starts.
Start Minute
The minute when the event begins. Default is 0. Example: Start Hour 20 and Start Minute 30 means the event begins at 8:30 PM.
Existing Zombie Batch Size
How many loaded zombies are refreshed per tick while a transition queue is active. Default is 300. Higher values refresh more zombies per pass; lower values spread the work out more slowly.
Timed zombie-night settings. Default is 6 PM to 6 AM. Test build uses night speed switching plus attraction pulse only; strength, hearing, sight, and memory options were removed for troubleshooting.
